description: Defines fixed-size structures and classes for HTTP/2 protocol frames and their fields, including constructors, size methods, and operators for comparison and output.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, including size, type, flags, and stream ID.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Contains priority information for an HTTP/2 stream, including dependency, weight, and exclusivity.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents the fields for RST_STREAM frame, mainly the error code.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Holds a setting parameter and its value for HTTP/2 settings.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Contains the promised stream ID in a PUSH_PROMISE frame.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Holds the opaque bytes for a PING frame.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Contains last stream ID and error code for GOAWAY frames.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents window size increment for WINDOW_UPDATE frames.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Contains origin length for ALTSVC frames.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the stream ID for priority update frames.

methods.name: EncodedSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the encoded structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the structure for debugging.

methods.name: IsSupportedErrorCode
methods.description: Checks if the error code is supported.

methods.name: IsSupportedHttp2ErrorCode
methods.description: External function to check if an error code is supported.

methods.name: IsSupportedHttp2SettingsParameter
methods.description: External function to check if a settings parameter is supported.

methods.name: StreamIdMask
methods.description: External constant/macro for stream ID bitmask.

methods.name: FlagsToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of flags.
